āṭa: [Aṭa+ṇa.a] (pu) CL=8 Gamane, ṇo, āṭo. Dhāna,ṭī.637.]  A bird with beak like spoon for cooking rice, a bird which is the eastern grey heron Ardea cinerea rectirostris.
āṭhapanā: [Ā+ṭhā+ṇāpe+yu]  CL=7 (A) First of all, establishing with respect, making actions such as walking and standing dignified and worthy of admiration. (B) Establishing with respect and care, taking actions done with great consideration to show reverence. (C) Performing actions such as walking and standing with careful effort, in a way that commands respect. See also - aṭṭhapanā.
āṭānāṭanagara: [Āṭānāṭā+nagara] (na) CL=8 City named Athanatha (the city of King Vesavana). Athanatiya - Look.( the city of Vessavaṇa deva(male deity called Kuvera). Āṭānāṭiya - see.
āṭānāṭiya: [Āṭānāṭā+iya] (ti) CL=8 (Because it was composed in Āṭānāṭā City )  named Āṭānāṭiya, Parita which is protector (or) fence.
āṭānāṭiyaparitta: [Āṭānāṭiya+paritta] (na) CL=8 free from harm dhamma which is called Āṭānāṭiya Parita(Sutta to ward off evil or harm).
āṭānāṭiyasutta: [Āṭānāṭiya+sutta] (na) CL=8 Āṭānāṭiya sutta, Suttas containing verses to be recited in the Āṭānāṭā city of the deva king Kuvera .
